chedchy occurs in B3 beside the much commoner chdy/chedy family; no distinct operation follows from its context.

qokchdy and okchedy/qokchedy overlap in B1 and B3 and occupy the same terminal operation slot.
otchedy/qotchedy and otchdy are section-local spellings of the same closed next-transfer command.
